summary: Temporal: restrict :depends-on, past-topic claims/habits/evaluations :before, conjunct chaining, reported -91 content has no temporal triple and inner events chain from the reporting verb. Modal: claim content gets author+speaker triples. Names listed as example characters are individual-person with the category noun as :op1. :quote on each conjunct, 等 as last :opN, no ARG0 from 他们的 in a claim. Aspect of claims/generic activities, 前第一夫人, 仍/都 no node, shared date re-entered. Trimmed redundant text to fit.

edits.old: Abridged UMR 0.9 guidelines for Chinese and English at Stage 1 (numbered PropBank roles), with the names of the UMR release data.

- Read the guidelines below first and return to them for every unsure decision.
- Follow
The 因为 clause (`:ARG2`, printed last) usually comes first in the text: entities first named there get their full nodes there.
- Temporal (5.1): 目前纸本停刊，网络版继续发行 → `(document-creation-time :depends-on s4e)` `(s4e :overlap s4e2)`; no triple for 目前; no temporal triple for `identity-91`.
Example (main event 发行 s1f, dependents 停止 s1s and 报导 s1b): `(document-creation-time :before s1f)`, `(s1f :overlap s1s)`, `(s1f :overlap s1b)`.
- 未经 (4.1): `(j / 经-01 :aspect process)` with no `:polarity`, plus the triple `(author :full-negative j)`.
- Classifier (2.2): 一份小报 → `(x / 小报 :quant 1 :unit (u / 份))`.

- Annotate event–event relations only when they are clear.
- Give
Use `:depends-on` when it is a current state, or a naming or evaluation that still holds (目前…, 被称为, 被誉为).
edits.new: Use `:depends-on` only with an explicit present marker (目前, 现在) or a naming still in force (被称为, 被誉为). Once the document has put its topic in the past (the paper stopped in 2007), its claims (宣称), habits (经常报导) and the author's evaluations of it (算是) are `(document-creation-time :before X)`.

edits.anchor: The main event is always the parent (first element).
edits.text: In `(and :op1 A :op2 B)`, B's parent is A: `(A :overlap B)`, never document-creation-time. A -91 node that is the content of a reporting verb gets no temporal triple; the first event inside it takes the reporting verb as parent, and further events on the same topic (other 报导) take that event as parent.

edits.anchor: node, or an event used as conceiver).
edits.text: The content events of a claim (and the events of a following clause that goes on about what was claimed) get both `(author :full-affirmative X)` and `(speaker :full-affirmative X)`; an event nested inside a claimed -91 state gets only the author triple.

edits.anchor: is the concept (`外星人 :name …`), not an appositive identity-91.
edits.text: But a name listed as an example of 人物/characters (如蝙蝠男孩、外星人P'Lod) is `individual-person`, the category noun its `:op1`; do not corefer it with a `外星人 :name` mention.

edits.old: - N 有 A、B…等 listing N's kinds → `N :example (and …)`, no 有 node.
edits.new: - N 有 A、B…等 listing N's kinds → `N :example (and …)`, no 有 node. 等 closing any list is the last `:opN` (`等`).

edits.text: If the content is an `and`/`consecutive`, put `:quote` on each event conjunct, never on the connective. 他们的 on an event noun inside a claim adds no `:ARG0`.

edits.anchor: - A passive naming or evaluation (被称为, 被誉为) is `performance`.
edits.text: - A single claim or announcement (宣称) is `performance`. A generic topic event noun (外星人在地球的活动) is `activity`, not habitual.

edits.old: 第一夫人 → `have-rel-role-91 :ARG3 (第一夫人 :place country)`, not have-org-role.
edits.new: 前第一夫人 → `have-rel-role-91 :ARG3 (第一夫人 :mod (前) :place country)`, not have-org-role; 前 never on the -91.

edits.old: Never drop them, and never move them onto a noun or onto the connective (`but-91`, `and`).
edits.new: Never drop them, and never move them onto a noun or onto the connective (`but-91`, `and`). Exceptions: 仍 next to 继续, and 都 before 以…为目的, get no node. A clause-initial date shared by two clauses is re-entered as `:temporal` of the second.

edits.old: - Name (2.2): 外星人P'Lod → `(x / 外星人 :name (n / name :op1 "P" :op2 "'" :op3 "Lod"))`.
edits.new:
- Name (2.2): 与外星人P'Lod有关系 → `(x / 外星人 :name (n / name :op1 "P" :op2 "'" :op3 "Lod"))`; 人物如蝙蝠男孩、外星人P'Lod等 → `(and … :op2 (i / individual-person :name (n / name :op1 "外星人" :op2 "P" :op3 "'" :op4 "Lod")) :op3 (d / 等))`.
- Past topic (5.1): (paper stopped 2007) 他们宣称… → `(document-creation-time :before 宣称)`; 经常报导A，创造B → `(dct :before 报导)` `(报导 :overlap 创造)`.
- Claim (5.1/5.2): 宣称 [他们的报导 都是真实的] → no temporal triple for have-mod-91; `(宣称 :overlap 报导)`; `(author :full-affirmative h)` `(paper :full-affirmative h)`; 报导 inside h: author triple only.
- 被指 X，后来Y → `(c / consecutive :op1 (X … :quote 指) :op2 (Y … :quote 指))`.
- 2007年停止纸本，(仍)继续网络版 → `继续 :temporal d` (re-entered), no 仍 node.
